title: SHOCK ABSORBER & BUMPER
summary: Rear shock absorber and the rubber rebound/jounce bumper on the rear frame rail, all models. The shock's upper eye bolts to the frame bracket with a bolt, lock washer and nut; its lower eye sits between two rubber grommets on a stud at the rear suspension and is held by a retainer, lock washer and nut, tightened with the car at "D" height. The bumper has its own stud that goes up through the frame and takes a nut on top.

parts.name: BUMPER ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Bumper assembly – rubber suspension bumper on rear frame rail

fastening.note: Shock upper eye: bolt [3] with lock washer [4] passes through the frame bracket and the shock eye; nut [5] on the outboard side.
Bumper [2] has its own stud (no callout) that goes up through a hole in the frame; nut [1] goes on from the top.

fastening.to: stud on the rear suspension below the frame (stud not called out)
fastening.note: Shock lower eye stack on the stud, inner to outer: grommet [6], shock eye, grommet [6], retainer [7], lock washer [8], nut [9]. Note A: tighten nut [9] with vehicle at "D" height. Note B: retainer [7] flared end curves away from grommet [6].

notes: A: Must be tightened with vehicle at "D" height specified for rear geometry setting.
B: Assemble with flared end curving away from 6
